principles.name: Business outcome traceability
principles.law: Every architecture decision MUST trace to an admitted business capability, objective, risk, or regulatory obligation.

principles.name: Zero ambient authority
principles.law: Planning and generation have no consequence authority. DO occurs only through explicit principal/capability/resource admission.

principles.name: Re-observe after consequence
principles.law: Every consequential transition invalidates stale future assumptions; the next planning episode starts from independently observed state.

principles.name: Preserve reversible options
principles.law: Prefer reversible and portable transformations until evidence justifies irreversible commitment.

principles.name: Data is governed by contract
principles.law: Data classification, residency, lineage, retention, ownership, and recovery requirements are planning inputs.

principles.name: Identity is the primary control plane
principles.law: Human, workload, service, and agent identities are explicit; least privilege and short-lived authority are defaults.

principles.name: Failure is designed, not discovered
principles.law: Verifier, rollback/recovery, degraded mode, and failure injection exist before production handoff.

principles.name: Observability is architecture
principles.law: Required evidence for SLO, security, cost, lineage, and process conformance is part of the design.

principles.name: Exit before entry
principles.law: Provider, product, model, and vendor exit constraints are evaluated before lock-in is accepted.

principles.name: Cost is a constrained state variable
principles.law: Unit economics, budget envelopes, capacity, and cost-failure modes participate in plan selection.

principles.name: Standards become machine constraints
principles.law: Policy/control requirements should be represented as ontology, shapes, rules, tests, or proofs rather than prose-only review.

principles.name: Compile away solved cognition
principles.law: Repeated, verified reasoning is projected into ggen packs, planner domains, tests, policies, or proofs and removed from the novelty path.
